rows.falsifier: Evidence showing that tightly coupled, non-decomposable systems outperform modular ones in creative tasks.
rows.reason: Reinforced by evidence that automated value system learning can be treated as a specific module within a broader decomposition.
rows.statement: Computational creativity frameworks depend on structured decomposition of problem-solving components to allow for independent modular improvement of formulation and evaluation.

rows.falsifier: A demonstration that creativity frameworks can achieve equivalent performance without adaptive value systems.
rows.reason: Updated to reflect that value system learning is a critical, missing integration point in many baseline creativity models.
rows.statement: Computational creativity frameworks require robust integration between formulation, representation, and adaptive learning of value systems to support autonomous progress.
